meta._source: ROUGH ESTIMATE — not measured. Derived from observed runtime stats during 2026-04-09 logfix/lazy-reload investigation: pre-fault avg running batch ~16-21, post-fault avg running batch ~26 on W1_Chat/Heavy. NOT calibrated via dedicated benchmark. The original decode_capacity_profile_8b.json was for A6000 dp=1 max_model_len=4096 planning_horizon=0.5 — completely wrong for current setup, causing Benders solver to declare admission infeasible on every epoch (decode_capacity=10 < active_running=25). See e1a_quick_diagnosis.md follow-up #6 (Benders profile mismatch). Note that even with this corrected profile, Benders may over-reject because the system runs ABOVE the 'safe' SLO-compliant capacity in practice.
